name: badge
description: A small inline label for a status or a count, tinted by a hue.

attributes.name: data-emphasis
attributes.description: medium is a subtle tint with dark text, high a solid fill, low text alone.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: The text size the badge sits beside; the badge renders one step smaller.

children.description: An optional icon, sized to the text.

tokens.name: --yeti-badge-radius
tokens.description: Corner radius; full makes a pill.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Gap between the icon and the text.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-primary
tokens.description: The default variant's color, when data-variant is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-on-primary
tokens.description: Text on the default variant's color.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-md
tokens.description: Text size when data-size is absent.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The space step when data-size is absent.

a11y.notes: A badge is text. If the color carries meaning, the text must carry it too. A count that belongs to a control goes into that control's accessible name, not beside it.
